Chainlink CCIP is a cross-chain interoperability protocol. Chainlink CCIP enables transfers of tokens and messages between blockchains. Chainlink CCIP operates through smart contracts on public blockchains.

0x project is a decentralized exchange protocol for trading tokens on Ethereum. 0x project is open-source. 0x project combines off-chain order relay with on-chain settlement. 0x project is used by third-party relayers and applications to build trading services.

dYdX is a decentralized exchange for cryptocurrency derivatives. dYdX offers perpetual futures trading. dYdX v3 ran on a StarkEx layer-2 network with off-chain order matching. dYdX v4 is built as a Cosmos-based application-specific blockchain.

Idex is a decentralized cryptocurrency exchange. Idex matches orders off-chain while settling trades on-chain.

FinNexus is a DeFi protocol operating on public blockchains. FinNexus provides on-chain financial services to users through smart contracts.
